description: Upload files via a file input element (by ref or selector). For hidden/gated inputs, click the visible upload button first to reveal the input. See browser_cheatsheet for per-platform upload flows.

nthMatch.description: If the selector matches multiple file inputs, upload to the Nth (0-indexed).

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector — exact match, no guessing.

selector.description: Playwright selector for the file input element (CSS, text="...", :has-text("..."), role=..., [data-testid="..."]). Fallback when you have no ref. NEVER use :contains().

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

textHint.description: What the upload control is, in words (e.g. "Add photo"). If the file input is not found, the visible controls are ranked against this phrase — usually the button that reveals the hidden input. Advisory.

name: browser_upload
